The name is derived from Sanskrit roots, with 'Amara' signifying 'Immortal' and 'Kumar' meaning 'Lord or Ruler'. This name is traditional and holds cultural significance within the Hindu community.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Amankumar" is rooted in the belief in the immortal God who rules and bestows his grace upon his followers.
